title: Replace a Tool Pocket on Your Haas Side Mount Tool Changer (SMTC)

steps.title: Position Damaged Pocket and Press Emergency Stop
Remove Cam Box Sheet Metal Cover Panels
Remove Tools, Mark Carousel Disk Alignment, and Remove Number Ring
Disconnect Pneumatic Air Supply and Remove Pilot Check Valve
Remove Pocket Stop, Shoulder Bolt, Retaining Bolt, and Damaged Pocket
Inspect Components and Lubricate Pocket Slider
Install Replacement Pocket and Fasten Hardware
Reinstall Pilot Check Valve, Number Disc, and Covers
Restore Power/Air, Reload Tools, and Test Tool Changer Operation

claims.text: The procedure is performed on a Haas Side Mount Tool Changer (SMTC).

evidence_links.explanation: Presenter states working on the side mount tool changer.

claims.text: Set machine rapids down to 25%.

evidence_links.explanation: Presenter explicitly instructs setting rapid overrides to 25%.

claims.text: Rotate the carousel to the damaged pocket.

evidence_links.explanation: Presenter instructs rotating the tool changer to the pocket needing replacement.

claims.text: Press Emergency Stop (E-stop) once the damaged pocket is in position.

evidence_links.explanation: Presenter states to hit e-stop after positioning the pocket.

claims.text: Remove four top fasteners located on top of the machine panel first.

evidence_links.explanation: Presenter specifies removing the four fasteners on top before panel removal.

claims.text: Remove the large panel on the left side and two smaller panel pieces below the double arm from the bottom of the cam box.

evidence_links.explanation: Presenter details removing three sheet metal pieces at the bottom of the cam box.

claims.text: Removing sheet metal panels provides physical access to the damaged pocket and its corresponding switches behind it.

evidence_links.explanation: Presenter explicitly explains this removal is required to gain access to the damaged pocket and switches.

claims.text: Remove all tools from the carousel and mark their original positions.

evidence_links.explanation: Presenter states to remove all tools and mark their locations.

claims.text: Mark both the carousel disk and the pocket to ensure correct alignment upon reinstallation.

evidence_links.explanation: Presenter marks disk and pocket to ensure proper disk installation later.

claims.text: Remove the number ring from the carousel.

evidence_links.explanation: Presenter removes the number ring.

claims.text: Marking positions ensures the carousel disk and tools are reinstalled correctly.

evidence_links.explanation: Presenter explains marking ensures correct reinstallation of the carousel disk.

claims.text: Disconnect main pneumatic air supply to the machine.

evidence_links.explanation: Presenter states to disconnect main air.

claims.text: Remove the pilot check valve.

evidence_links.explanation: Presenter removes the pilot check valve.

claims.text: Removing the pilot check valve allows the pocket to move up and down freely to gain access to mounting screws.

evidence_links.explanation: Presenter notes removing check valve allows free vertical movement of pocket to reach screw.

claims.text: Remove four bolts from the pocket stop and remove the pocket stop.

evidence_links.explanation: Presenter unbolts and removes pocket stop.

claims.text: Remove the shoulder bolt located on the backside of the carousel right next to the lower proximity switch.

evidence_links.explanation: Presenter removes shoulder bolt from back side of carousel near proximity switch.

claims.text: Remove the retaining bolt and extract the damaged pocket from the assembly.

evidence_links.explanation: Presenter removes retaining bolt and lifts out the pocket.

claims.text: Rotate the cam follower to confirm it spins freely.

evidence_links.explanation: Presenter instructs rotating cam follower to check free movement.

claims.text: Check the plungers inside the pocket to ensure they are not worn out.

evidence_links.explanation: Presenter instructs checking internal plungers for wear.

claims.text: Apply grease to the pocket slider.

evidence_links.explanation: Presenter states applying grease inside pocket slider.

claims.text: Assemble the new pocket onto the slider and position both back into place.

evidence_links.explanation: Presenter states attaching new pocket to slider and placing back in position.

claims.text: Reinstall the retainer bolt and tighten securely.

evidence_links.explanation: Presenter reinstalls and tightens retainer bolt.

claims.text: Lower the pocket, attach the shoulder bolt, and screw it in.

evidence_links.explanation: Presenter lowers pocket and fastens shoulder bolt.

claims.text: Reinstall the pocket stop hardware.

evidence_links.explanation: Presenter installs the pocket stop.

claims.text: The installed pocket moves freely and triggers pocket-up and pocket-down proximity switches properly.

evidence_links.explanation: Presenter observes pocket moves freely and switches read pocket up/down status.

claims.text: Pocket movement is smooth and pocket up/down proximity switches generate correct signals.

evidence_links.explanation: Presenter confirms free movement and switch output reading.

claims.text: Reinstall the pilot check valve.

evidence_links.explanation: Presenter states installing check valve.

claims.text: Reinstall the number disc by aligning the dot on the number disc with the dot on the pocket.

evidence_links.explanation: Presenter aligns alignment dots on disc and pocket.

claims.text: Reinstall the remaining three sheet metal cover panels.

evidence_links.explanation: Presenter reinstalls three panels.

claims.text: Reinstall all tools into their original carousel locations.

evidence_links.explanation: Presenter installs tools back.

claims.text: Turn on main pneumatic air supply and release the E-stop.

evidence_links.explanation: Presenter restores air supply and releases e-stop.

claims.text: Run the tool changer through several tool changes.

evidence_links.explanation: Presenter instructs running tool changer through multiple tool changes to verify function.

claims.text: All sheet metal panels must be secured, main air turned on, and tool changer operates flawlessly through several test tool changes.

evidence_links.explanation: Presenter outlines test verification criteria.
Presenter outlines test verification criteria.
